summary.text: Joe Major is the Democratic incumbent state senator for the Windsor District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A U.S. Army veteran, he took office in January 2025 and is vice chair of the Agriculture Committee.

paragraphs.text: Major served in the U.S. Army and earned a bachelor's degree from Howard University.
He took office in the Vermont State Senate on January 8, 2025, and his 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Agriculture Committee, where he is vice chair, and the Institutions Committee.
